name: NuminaMath
description: A large-scale mathematical reasoning dataset curated by Numina AI, containing problems from Chinese high school math competitions, international olympiads, and AIME-level competitions. Used for training and evaluating mathematical reasoning in LLMs.
typical_sota_score: N/A (primarily a training dataset with evaluation split)
reputation: Won the AI Mathematical Olympiad (AIMO) competition in 2024; large-scale dataset enabling math reasoning fine-tuning
notes: Primarily used as a training dataset for math reasoning. The associated NuminaMath-CoT model won the 2024 AI Mathematical Olympiad (AIMO) prize competition. Contains chain-of-thought solutions.
